verses.translation: And the word of the Lord came to Michæas the son of Morasthi, in the days of Joatham, and Achaz, and Ezekias, kings of Juda, concerning what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem.

translations.ron: Cuvântul Domnului care a fast către Miheia din Moreşet în vremea domniei lui Iotam, Ahaz şi Iezechia, regii lui Iuda, când a avut vedenie pentru Samaria şi Ierusalim.
translations.grk: ΚΑΙ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Μιχαίαν τὸν τοῦ Μωρασθεὶ, ἐν ἡμέραις Ἰωάθαμ, καὶ Ἄχαζ, καὶ Ἐζεκίου βασιλέων Ἰούδα, ὑπὲρ ὧν εἶδε περὶ Σαμαρείας καὶ περὶ Ἱερουσαλήμ.

verses.translation: Hear these words, ye people; and let the earth give heed, and all that are in it: and the Lord God shall be among you for a testimony, the Lord out of his holy habitation.

translations.ron: Ascultaţi, voi neamuri toate, ia aminte pământule şi tot ce se află pe tine! Căci Domnul Dumnezeu va fi vouă mărturie împotriva voastră, Domnul din templul cel sfânt al Său!
translations.grk: Ἀκούσατε λαοὶ λόγους, καὶ προσεχέτω ἡ γῆ, καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐν αὐτῇ· καὶ ἔσται Κύριος Κύριος ἐν ὑμῖν εἰς μαρτύριον, Κύριος ἐξ οἴκου ἁγίου αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: For, behold, the Lord comes forth out of his place, and will come down, and will go upon the high places of the earth.

translations.ron: Căci iată Domnul va ieşi din locaşul Lui, Se va pogorî şi va păşi peste înălţimile pământului;
translations.grk: Διότι ἰδοὺ Κύριος ἐκπορεύεται ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ, καὶ καταβήσεται, καὶ ἐπιβήσεται ἐπὶ τὰ ὕψη τῆς γῆς,

verses.translation: And the mountains shall be shaken under him, and the valleys shall melt like wax before the fire, and as water rushing down a declivity.

translations.ron: Munţii se vor topi sub El ca ceara în faţa focului şi văile vor curge, cum se pornesc la vale apele pe povârniş.
translations.grk: καὶ σαλευθήσεται τὰ ὄρη ὑποκάτωθεν αὐτοῦ, καὶ αἱ κοιλάδες τακήσονται ὡσεὶ κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου πυρὸς, καὶ ὡς ὕδωρ καταφερόμενον ἐν καταβάσει.

verses.translation: All these calamities are for the transgression of Jacob, and for the sin of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what is the sin of the house of Juda? is it not Jerusalem?

translations.ron: Toate acestea vor fi din pricina fărădelegii lui Iacov şi a păcatului casei lui Israel. Care este fărădelegea lui Iacov? Oare nu Samaria? Şi care sunt înălţimile lui Iuda? Oare nu Ierusalimul?
translations.grk: Διʼ ἀσέβειαν Ἰακὼβ πάντα ταῦτα, καὶ διʼ ἁμαρτίαν οἴκου Ἰσραήλ· τίς ἡ ἀσέβεια τοῦ Ἰακώβ; οὐχ ἡ Σαμάρεια; καὶ τίς ἡ ἁμαρτία οἴκου Ἰούδα; οὐχὶ Ἱερουσαλήμ;

verses.translation: Therefore I will make Samaria as a store-house of the fruits of the field, and as a planting of a vineyard: and I will utterly demolish her stones, and I will expose her foundations.

translations.ron: Pentru aceasta voi preface Samaria într-o grămadă de pietre adunate de pe câmp, când se sădeşte via; voi prăvăli în vale pietrele ei şi temeliile ei le voi dezveli.
translations.grk: Καὶ θήσομαι Σαμάρειαν εἰς ὀπωροφυλάκιον ἀγροῦ, καὶ εἰς φυτείαν ἀμπελῶνος, καὶ κατασπάσω εἰς χάος τοὺς λίθους αὐτῆς, καὶ τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῆς ἀποκαλύψω.

verses.translation: And they shall cut in pieces all the graven images, and all that she has hired they shall burn with fire, and I will utterly destroy all her idols: because she has gathered of the hires of fornication, and of the hires of fornication has she amassed wealth.

translations.ron: Toate chipurile ei cele cioplite vor fi doborâte, toată bogăţia adunată din preţul desfrânării va fi arsă în foc şi toate chipurile ei de idoli le voi face una cu pământul; căci din plată de desfrânată i-a adunat şi în plată de desfrânată se vor preface!
translations.grk: Καὶ πάντα τὰ γλυπτὰ αὐτῆς κατακόψουσι, καὶ πάντα τὰ μισθώματα αὐτῆς ἐμπρήσουσιν ἐν πυρὶ, καὶ πάντα τὰ εἴδωλα αὐτῆς θήσομαι εἰς ἀφανισμόν· διότι ἐκ μισθωμάτων πορνείας συνήγαγε, καὶ ἐκ μισθωμάτων πορνείας συνέστρεψεν.

verses.translation: Therefore shall she lament and wail, she shall go barefooted, and being naked she shall make lamentation as that of serpents, and mourning as of the daughters of sirens.

translations.ron: Din această pricină Mă voi tângui şi voi urla, voi merge desculţ şi gol; voi scoate urlete ca şacalii şi ţipete ca struţii;
translations.grk: Ἕνεκεν τούτου κόψεται, καὶ θρηνήσει, πορεύσεται ἀνυπόδετος, καὶ γυμνὴ ποιήσεται κοπετὸν ὡς δρακόντων, καὶ πένθος ὡς θυγατέρων σειρήνων.

verses.translation: For her plague has become grievous; for it has come even to Juda; and has reached to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

translations.ron: Căci rana ei este fără de leac, ajuns-a până în Iuda, atins-a porţile poporului Meu, până la Ierusalim.
translations.grk: Ὅτι κατεκράτησεν ἡ πληγὴ αὐτῆς, διότι ἦλθεν ἕως Ἰούδα, καὶ ἥψατο ἕως πύλης λαοῦ μου, ἕως Ἱερουσαλήμ.

verses.translation: Ye that are in Geth, exalt not yourselves, and ye Enakim, do not rebuild from the ruins of the house in derision: sprinkle dust in the place of your laughter.

translations.ron: Nu daţi de veste în Gat, şi în Aco, nu plângeţi! În Bet-Leafra tăvăliţi-vă în pulbere!
translations.grk: Οἱ ἐν Γὲθ μὴ μεγαλύνεσθε, καὶ οἱ Ἐνακεὶμ μὴ ἀνοικοδομεῖτε ἐξ οἴκου κατὰ γέλωτα, γῆν καταπάσασθε καταγέλωτα ὑμῶν,

verses.translation: The inhabitant of Sennaar, fairly inhabiting her cities, came not forth to mourn for the house next to her: she shall receive of you the stroke of grief.

translations.ron: Cornul sună pentru voi, locuitori din Şafir. şi din cetatea lor nu ies cei din Taanan. Plângere se aude în Bet-Haeţel, căci veţi fi lipsiţi de sprijin.
translations.grk: κατοικοῦσα καλῶς τὰς πόλεις αὐτῆς, οὐκ ἐξῆλθε κατοικοῦσα Σενναὰρ, κόψασθαι οἶκον ἐχόμενον αὐτῆς, λήψεται ἐξ ὑμῶν πληγὴν ὀδύνης.

verses.translation: Who has begun to act for good to her that dwells in sorrow? for calamities have come down from the Lord upon the gates of Jerusalem,

translations.ron: Cum să nădăjduiască locuitorii cei din Marot că le va fi bine, când nenorocirea de la Domnul s-a coborât la porţile Ierusalimului?
translations.grk: Τίς ἥρξατο εἰς ἀγαθὰ κατοικούσῃ ὀδύνας; ὅτι κατέβη κακὰ παρὰ Κυρίου ἐπὶ πύλας Ἱερουσαλὴμ,

verses.translation: even a sound of chariots and horsemen: the inhabitants of Lachis, she is the leader of sin to the daughter of Sion: for in thee were found the transgressions of Israel.

translations.ron: Înhămaţi caii la căruţă, locuitori ai Lachişului! Iată începutul ispăşirii păcatului fiicei Sionului, căci în tine s-au aflat fărădelegile lui Israel.
translations.grk: ψόφος ἁρμάτων καὶ ἱππευόντων· κατοικοῦσα Λαχεὶς, ἀρχηγὸς ἁμαρτίας αὕτη ἐστὶ τῇ θυγατρὶ Σιὼν, ὅτι ἐν σοὶ εὑρέθησαν ἀσέβειαι τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: Therefore shall he cause men to be sent forth as far as the inheritance of Geth, even vain houses; they are become vanity to the kings of Israel;

translations.ron: De aceea tu vei renunţa să stăpâneşti Moreşet-Gat; casele Aczibului vor fi o dezamăgire pentru regii Israelului!
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο δώσει ἐξαποστελλομένους ἕως κληρονομίας Γὲθ, οἴκους ματαίους, εἰς κενὸν ἐγένοντο τοῖς βασιλεῦσι τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ,

verses.translation: until they bring the heirs, O inhabitant of Lachis: the inheritance shall reach to Odollam, even the glory of the daughter of Israel.

translations.ron: Îţi voi aduce un nou cuceritor ţie care locuieşti în Mareşa; strălucirea Israelului va merge până la Odolam!
translations.grk: ἕως τοὺς κληρονόμους ἀγάγωσι, κατοικοῦσα Λαχείς· κληρονομία ἕως Ὀδολλὰμ ἥξει, ἡ δόξα τὴς θυγατρὸς Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: Shave thine hair, and make thyself bald for thy delicate children; increase thy widowhood as an eagle; for thy people are gone into captivity from thee.

translations.ron: Fii pleşuvă şi te rade pentru copiii tăi cei dragi, măreşte-ţi pleşuvia ca a vulturului, căci ei au fost duşi în robie, departe de tine!
translations.grk: Ξύρησαι, καὶ κεῖραι ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα τὰ τρυφερά σου, ἐμπλάτυνον τὴν χηρείαν σου ὡς ἀετὸς, ὅτι ᾐχμαλωτεύθησαν ἀπὸ σοῦ.
